title: Linking Words and Clear Academic Style
objective: Students connect ideas with simple academic transitions and avoid overly complicated wording.
context: Notes: The first tree had 7 birds. The second had 2. We counted on one day. We need more visits.

items.prompt: Join the first two ideas with “while”.
items.answer: The first tree had seven birds, while the second had two.
items.hint: Use while to compare two places.

items.prompt: Join the last two ideas with “because”.
items.answer: We need more visits because we counted on only one day.

items.prompt: Write a short paragraph using your two sentences. Check that both ideas connect clearly.
items.answer: Accept an accurate comparison, a clear reason for more visits, and correct linking words.
items.hint: Read it aloud. Check the places and numbers.
